name: Warden
description: Automated *Arr search scheduling and stalled-download cleanup for Sonarr, Radarr, and Lidarr.

paths.name: Config Directory
paths.description: Warden config directory. Place config.yaml (and optionally .env) here. The container loads .env on startup — variables set below take priority over .env.

paths.name: Env File
paths.description: Optional .env file with API keys and other secrets. Container loads this on startup — variables set below take priority over .env.

variables.name: Warden Mode
variables.description: Controls which subsystems run. warden runs both Vigilance (search) and Defence (cleanup). vigilance runs search-only. defence runs cleanup-only.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone for logs and active-hours windows, e.g. Australia/Sydney.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Python logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

variables.name: Sonarr API Key
variables.description: Sonarr API key. Reference in config.yaml as ${SONARR_API_KEY} . Sonarr → Settings → General → API Key. (Running multiple Sonarr instances? Add more variables here and reference them in config.yaml.)

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: Radarr API key. Reference in config.yaml as ${RADARR_API_KEY} . Radarr → Settings → General → API Key.

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: Lidarr API key. Reference in config.yaml as ${LIDARR_API_KEY} . Lidarr → Settings → General → API Key.
